resources.string: Your audio goes through the developer’s relay server to Google’s Gemini, and only the feedback comes back. The server does not store audio. No API key needed.
Sends directly to Google’s Gemini with your own API key. No developer server, no daily limit.
After deleting, “Your own Gemini key” won’t work until you enter a key again. “Default” keeps working.

The key is stored encrypted, only on this device. Your audio and what you said go directly to Google’s Gemini API with your key; no developer server is involved. Depending on your region the free tier may not apply and usage may be billed (a few cents per review).
A key starting with AIza… or AQ…
Paste a key created at Google AI Studio. It is stored only on this device.

The coach’s feedback, live captions and read-aloud voice follow this language. US and UK English, and Spain and Latin American Spanish, each get their own spelling and phrasing. Explanations follow the device’s language.
Show live captions while speaking (device speech recognition)
Captions are only a reference. Feedback is based on the recorded audio itself, so caption errors are never “corrected”.
Corrected sentences and today’s phrases are read aloud with the device’s voice. No network, no cost.
Of those, untried phrases at most

How many phrases appear on the Speak tab each day. Phrases you missed (✗, △) and phrases that are due come first; untried phrases fill the remaining slots. A number you can comfortably work in keeps you going longer than a bigger one.
✗ Import failed (this doesn’t look like a Hitorigoto export file)

Export and import your records (sessions, recurring points, phrase list) as JSON. Export files from the Chrome extension and the iPhone app can be imported as well. Imports are merged, so duplicates are not added.
